node.html: Luminate is a telehealth appointment platform that enables patients to book video consultations based on doctors' available time slots. It features reusable booking and slot-selection interfaces for browsing doctor availability, secure video consultation workflows for patient–doctor sessions, and REST API integrations for managing doctor and patient schedules. The application follows Clean Architecture with GetX to ensure maintainable and testable modules, while Jenkins CI/CD automates builds, testing, and deployment.

ScreenSavvy is a digital wellness application designed to help students reduce screen time through engaging, gamified challenges. It combines a point-based rewards system with real-time screen-usage tracking and progress insights, while social competition with friends and family encourages users to build healthier digital habits.

Bazaar App is a large-scale, UAE-based multi-category e-commerce marketplace serving thousands of daily shoppers. It features a scalable product architecture with dynamic variants and inventory management, advanced discount logic, and personalized product recommendations. The application supports deep linking for seamless navigation, WebSocket-based real-time order updates, and secure Stripe checkout integration. Advanced caching and performance profiling helped improve application loading time by 35%.

CirclePR is a corporate gifting automation platform that helps businesses streamline employee and client gifting through smart catalogs and integrated payments. The application includes automated gifting workflows, catalog segmentation, reusable UI components, and admin tools for managing catalogs, orders, and users. Prefetching and client-side caching improved feed loading speed by 40%, while Stripe, Apple Pay, and Google Pay support cross-platform payments.

DePassport is an AI-powered compatibility platform that connects people for dating, mentorship, and fitness partnerships through intelligent matching scores. The app combines optimized user interfaces and deep navigation flows with client-side caching for faster content loading. It also integrates cross-platform payments through Stripe, Apple Pay, and Google Pay, supported by low-latency API integrations.

Riderem is a multi-restaurant food delivery marketplace connecting customers, restaurants, and riders through synchronized applications powered by shared backend services. It includes real-time order tracking, rider assignment workflows, and Google Maps integration for live location tracking, routing, and ETA calculation. Its data models and shared services support multiple restaurant operations and a consistent experience across the customer, restaurant, and rider apps.

JJ’s Deliveries is a food delivery marketplace connecting customers, restaurants, and delivery drivers through three interconnected applications backed by a unified backend. It includes real-time delivery tracking, driver assignment workflows, and Google Maps integration for live location, routing, and distance calculations. Structured data modeling reduced Firebase read and write costs by 60%, while shared backend synchronization supports the different user roles.

TheEmpire is a digital banking application that enables users to send and receive money, track transactions, and manage payments. The mobile experience includes intuitive money-transfer flows, transaction history, and balance tracking, with a focus on responsive interfaces and reliable integration with banking APIs.

AI Chatbot is an intelligent assistant application that supports natural conversations, AI-powered image generation, and content tools. It includes context-aware chat experiences, image generation using Stable Diffusion, keyword and content generation utilities, user authentication, and cloud data storage. Stripe integration supports premium features.

Calendar2Alarm is a productivity application that converts calendar events into alarms based on user preferences. It synchronizes calendar events and triggers alarms using user-defined rules, with background execution and scheduled tasks designed to keep reminders reliable even when the app is closed.
